# Prompt Role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PromptRole`](gmeow-PromptRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PromptRole>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An open value vocabulary of conversational prompt roles.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PromptRole`](gmeow-PromptRole.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for the prompt-role axis — the conversational roles (system, user, assistant, tool, …) that [`gmeow:promptRole`](../properties/gmeow-promptRole.md) draws from; mint a fresh individual for a role not seeded.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a prompt-role SUBCLASS of [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md) (the role is a value, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid confusing it with [`gmeow:ParticipantRole`](gmeow-ParticipantRole.md) — prompt roles are conversational turns, not event participation.

### How to use

- Add a new role as a [`gmeow:PromptRole`](gmeow-PromptRole.md) individual with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and [skos:definition](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition); reference it from a [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md) via [`gmeow:promptRole`](../properties/gmeow-promptRole.md).

### Examples

- ex:promptRoleTool a [`gmeow:PromptRole`](gmeow-PromptRole.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "tool"@en.
